description: This file defines the LocationCaptureManager class, which manages retrieving device location using Android's LocationManager, handling permissions, cached locations, and timeouts.

classes.name: LocationCaptureManager
classes.description: A class for managing location retrieval, including permission checks, cached location use, and timeout handling.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Suspends coroutine to retrieve current location with given preferences and parameters.

methods.name: bestLastKnown
methods.description: Returns the best last known location if within max age and permissions are granted.

methods.name: requestCurrent
methods.description: Requests the current location asynchronously with timeout and permission checks.
